objective: Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

description: The pendant? Of course you can have it... Take it! I want no memory of him... just please, please leave in peace...
completion: It is strange that the Warchief would expend so much over such a small thing. I do not claim to understand him, but I will follow him, whatever his commands. You did well, <name>, no doubt the Warchief will be glad to hear of your success.
